resources.string: Incoming-call-style full-screen reminder alarms and follow-up actions. Not a cellular call.
Type or dictate a reminder like "Remind me at 6 AM to finish my mathematics assignment".
Local app alarm experience • Not a cellular call

NEXUS uses high-priority local notifications to wake your screen and show Dismiss / Talk to NEXUS controls when a reminder fires. Without it, reminders still save locally and trigger when the app is open.
On Android 12+, exact alarm access lets NEXUS ring precisely at 6:00 AM. If left off, NEXUS gracefully falls back to battery-saver inexact delivery (which may drift a few minutes under Doze).

On Android 14+, Full-Screen Intent allows the incoming-call-style alarm screen to appear over the lock screen. If disabled, NEXUS shows a heads-up notification with Answer and Dismiss buttons instead.

NEXUS uses Android on-device/system speech recognition only when you tap the microphone to dictate reminders or voice replies. Nothing is uploaded by NEXUS, and typed input always works without mic permission.
